## 1. Study Summary & Metadata Categorization

> **Diabetes (Mouse Pancreatic Islets)** -- Hrovatin et al. 2023, *Nature Metabolism* 5(9):1644-1662, PMID 37697055. Single-cell atlas of 264,235 mouse pancreatic islet cells from 52 samples across 9 distinct source studies (`dataset`), sequencing protocols (`10x 3' v2` vs `v3`), and disease states (`T2D` vs `ND`). Note: mouse gene symbols require ortholog mapping prior to automated annotation.

### Metadata Collinearity Matrix (Normalized Mutual Information)

> **Collinearity Diagnostic:** Quantifies pairwise non-linear association among all biological and technical covariates at the sample level using Normalized Mutual Information (NMI $\in [0, 1]$). Values $> 0.70$ indicate severe collinearity and confounding.

```{python}
all_cand_cols = list(dict.fromkeys([BIO_COL] + ECODA_SECONDARY_BIO + BATCH_COLS))
nmi_mat = ou.compute_metadata_nmi_matrix(sub.obs, SAMPLE_COL, all_cand_cols)
fig_nmi = ou.plot_metadata_nmi_heatmap(nmi_mat, title=f"Metadata Collinearity Matrix (NMI) — {NAME}")
plt.figure(fig_nmi.number)
plt.show()
```

## 4. Unintegrated Embeddings (Fresh PCA + UMAP)

> **Embedding Protocol:** Computed directly from processed raw counts (total counts normalized to 10k, log1p, 2000 HVGs via Seurat v3 paper flavor, scaled PCA 50 PCs, standard Scanpy UMAP with `min_dist=0.5, spread=1.0`). **No pre-existing or batch-corrected embeddings are used.**

```{python}
label_cols = [c for c in [SAMPLE_COL, BIO_COL] + BATCH_COLS + [CT_COL] if c and c in sub.obs.columns]
um = ou.embed_and_umap_workflow(
    sub, label_cols=label_cols, out_dir=None, name=NAME,
    sample_col=SAMPLE_COL,
)
sub_embedded = um["subset"]

for fig in um["figs"]:
    plt.figure(fig.number)
    plt.show()
```

## 5. Variance Partition & Distance PERMANOVA Across Covariates

> **Variance Partitioning Protocol:**
> 1. **Cell-Type Specific Variance Partitioning:** Quantifies the fraction of inter-sample variance in cell-type abundance explained by each biological vs. technical covariate across cell types and whole cohort average (`Whole atlas`), following Sikkema et al. 2023 (*Nature Medicine* 29:1563–1577, Fig. 4a).
> 2. **Global Distance PERMANOVA & Variance Decomposition:** Partitions total inter-sample Aitchison distance variance (Euclidean distance on CLR composition) into **Unique Biological**, **Unique Technical**, **Shared/Confounded**, and **Residual** variance via multi-variable marginal PERMANOVA with permutation tests (Anderson 2001).

```{python}
bio_candidates = list(dict.fromkeys([c for c in [BIO_COL] + ECODA_SECONDARY_BIO if c in sub.obs.columns]))
tech_candidates = list(dict.fromkeys([c for c in BATCH_COLS if c in sub.obs.columns]))

for annot_col in ALL_CT_COLS:
    if annot_col not in sub.obs.columns:
        continue
    clr_curr = ou.compute_clr_composition(sub.obs, SAMPLE_COL, annot_col)
    
    # 1. Feature-level variance partition heatmap (Sikkema et al.)
    var_tech, var_bio = ou.compute_variance_partition(
        clr_curr, sub.obs, SAMPLE_COL, bio_candidates, tech_candidates
    )
    
    fig_var = ou.plot_variance_partition_heatmap(
        var_tech, var_bio,
        title=f"Fraction of Total Variance Explained Across Covariates — {annot_col}"
    )
    plt.figure(fig_var.number)
    plt.show()

    # 2. Global Distance PERMANOVA & Variance Decomposition
    univar_perm, joint_perm, stats_text = ou.compute_compositional_permanova(
        clr_curr, sub.obs, SAMPLE_COL, bio_candidates, tech_candidates, n_permutations=999
    )
    
    fig_perm = ou.plot_compositional_permanova(
        univar_perm, joint_perm,
        title=f"Compositional Distance Variance Decomposition (PERMANOVA) — {annot_col}"
    )
    plt.figure(fig_perm.number)
    plt.show()

    print(stats_text)
```
